subject: Re: Kickoff: AFE - automated feature engineering as a platform play
body:
Status ahead of the OKR lock.

Good news: the discovery-model trainer reproduces cleanly on the housing-price regression task (airbnb2023_float table, price target, 10-step config from our open-source release). On the two alpha partners' tasks, AFE-selected transforms beat their hand-built feature sets by 3.2% and 1.8% on their primary metrics.

The trade-off we need to discuss: global masking picks transforms that generalize across the dataset, but for one partner the win comes almost entirely from local masks on a handful of high-cardinality categoricals. Serving local masks means per-segment feature pipelines, which roughly doubles the serving-side work Rosa scoped. Options: ship global-only for v1 (smaller win, simpler), or slip the August review by two weeks.

Yusuf and I lean global-only. Flagging now so it's a decision, not a surprise.

Linnea
